policy: O*NET-linked tasks (tasks O*NET assigns to the occupation), retained reviewed_yes assignments, or retained unreviewed tasks supported by more than 200 sampled job-months in this occupation. Parent SOC6 task identities additionally require permission in every contributing specialty, preventing parent-minus-child reconstruction. Other assignments remain anonymous.
anonymous_cloud: Aggregate size-band counts; synthetic positions independent of restricted task IDs.
review_artifact_policy: Separately authorized selected review IDs, public taxonomy labels and verdicts; no posting frequencies, excerpts or record identifiers. Explorer profile disclosure rules remain unchanged.
